title: Autodesk (ADSK) Falls More Steeply Than Broader Market: What Investors Need to Know
author: Zacks.Com
description: Autodesk stock fell 3.88% on November 17, 2026, underperforming the S&P 500's 1.03% decline. Despite a 10.32% monthly gain, the company faces upcoming earnings on November 24 with expected EPS of $3.07 (up 14.98% YoY) and revenue of $2.13 billion (up 14.96% YoY). The stock holds a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) with a Forward P/E of 21.03, trading at a slight premium to its industry average.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: While the stock experienced a steeper daily decline (-3.88%) compared to broader market indices, strong expected earnings growth (14.98% EPS, 14.96% revenue YoY) and a solid monthly performance (+10.32%) provide offsetting positive factors. The Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating and valuation metrics trading at a slight premium to industry averages support a neutral outlook ahead of earnings.

title: CRM or ADSK: Which Is the Better Value Stock Right Now?
author: Na
description: A comparison of Salesforce (CRM) and Autodesk (ADSK) in the Internet-Software sector reveals that Salesforce presents a better value opportunity. CRM has a Zacks Rank of #2 (Buy) versus ADSK's #3 (Hold), with superior valuation metrics including a forward P/E of 13.31 compared to ADSK's 21.32, a PEG ratio of 0.78 versus 1.37, and a P/B ratio of 4.77 versus 16.63. CRM received a Value grade of B while ADSK received a C.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Salesforce demonstrates stronger fundamentals with a higher Zacks Rank (#2 Buy vs #3 Hold), lower forward P/E ratio (13.31 vs 21.32), better PEG ratio (0.78 vs 1.37), lower P/B ratio (4.77 vs 16.63), and a superior Value grade (B vs C), indicating it is undervalued relative to Autodesk and presents a better value opportunity.

Autodesk is rated as a Hold with weaker valuation metrics compared to Salesforce, including higher P/E and PEG ratios and a lower Value grade (C), suggesting it is less attractive as a value investment opportunity at current price levels.

title: Twilio Q3 Earnings Beat Estimates on Strong Revenue Growth
author: Na
description: Twilio exceeded Q3 2026 earnings expectations with non-GAAP EPS of $1.65 (13% beat) and revenues of $1.56 billion (20% YoY growth).
